inspiration.observed_pattern: JSON_OVERLAPS returns a true integer result when two JSON arrays share one scalar element.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Minimized to one independently authored array pair so the MariaDB integer metadata contract is the only observable regression signal.

fixture_notes: Both arrays contain the fixed scalar 7, so JSON_OVERLAPS must return integer 1.
determinism_notes: One fixed primary-key row is selected in ID order. There are no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE json_overlap_min (pair_id INT PRIMARY KEY, left_document JSON NOT NULL, right_document JSON NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT pair_id, JSON_OVERLAPS(left_document, right_document) AS overlaps FROM json_overlap_min ORDER BY pair_id

checks.sql: SELECT pair_id FROM json_overlap_min ORDER BY pair_id
